items.prompt: Bar 1 shows two thirds. Shade bar 2 so it shows the same amount.
hints: Multiply the shaded parts by 4 too.
items.explanation: Two thirds is the same as 8 twelfths, because 2 times 4 is 8 and 3 times 4 is 12.

items.prompt: Bar 1 shows three sixths. Cut bar 2 any way that can show the same amount, then shade it.
hints: Three sixths is the same as one half.
Pick a number of parts that can be split into 2 equal groups.
For example 4 parts with 2 shaded, or 8 parts with 4 shaded.
items.explanation: Three sixths is one half. Any even number of parts works, shading half of them.

items.prompt: Bar 1 shows five tenths. Shade bar 2 so it shows the same amount.
hints: Five tenths is the same as one half.
Bar 2 has 4 parts, and half of 4 is 2.
items.explanation: Five tenths is one half, and one half of bar 2 is 2 of its 4 parts.
